messages:
jasmin_support: Quick heads-up — planning a rolling maintenance window for dedicated runtime nodes tomorrow 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC (45m window). Purpose: apply critical runtime patch (KV cache leak + kernel pin). Impact: brief rolling restarts, expected transient latency bump 5-10% for ~5m per shard. No data migration or auth changes. Need final statuspage + customer email copy for approval.
sam_ops: Ack. I'll run canary on 2 small hosts first, then 10% fleet, then full roll. Rollback criteria: error rate > 0.5% or p95 spike > 2x baseline during canary. Rollback playbook ready.
alex_dev: Patch details: pins kernel -> kgv-1.2.3, fixes kv_cache.free() race. Minimal surface area. Recommend rolling restart with 10s drain + 15s warmup per instance. Targets: keep concurrency steady using gradual traffic shift.
deploy-bot: Job scheduled: job_id=deploy-1918205555-rtpatch, change_window=45m, canary_hosts=2, rollout_steps=[10%,50%,100%]. ETA: 03:00 UTC.
megan_custsuccess: Draft language suggestions:
- For statuspage banner keep short and factual.
- For email include expected timeline, impact, who to contact, and a link to dedicated status page entry.
eric_pm: Two policy notes: 1) For Dedicated customers with pinned runtime versions, we should not auto-upgrade — include opt-in instructions. 2) For customers using Redwood Private, remind them this patch is for hosted Dedicated only unless on the optional package.
jasmin_support: Copy proposal (status page banner):
```
Scheduled maintenance: Rolling runtime patch for Dedicated fleet
Start: 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC — Duration: ~45 minutes (rolling)
Impact: Possible short latency increase (5–10%) for small groups of requests during rolling restarts. No expected downtime or data loss. If you rely on pinned runtime versions, you will not be upgraded automatically. Updates here throughout the window: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1918205555
```
jasmin_support: Customer email draft (short):
```
Subject: Scheduled maintenance — Dedicated runtime patch (Apr 2, 03:00 UTC)
Hi <CustomerTeam>,
We will perform a rolling runtime patch on our Dedicated fleet on Apr 2 at 03:00 UTC. This maintenance will take ~45 minutes and may cause brief latency increases for a small portion of traffic as instances restart. There will be no data migration or authentication changes.
If you have pinned runtime versions and do not want this update, reply to this email or contact your CSM before Apr 1 17:00 UTC to opt out.
We will post live updates on our status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1918205555
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```
sam_ops: Suggest adding an automated note in the statuspage timeline when canary begins and when full roll is started/finished. I'll trigger statusbot updates at each milestone.
statusbot: Staging status entry created: https://staging-status.redwood.ai/incidents/1918205555 (will promote to public on approval)
alex_dev: Quick check — can we include a short line for devs: "No change to API surface or tokens; only runtime update" ? That helps reduce support noise.
megan_custsuccess: +1 to the API line. Also add CSM contact placeholder: csm@example.com and 24/7 support link.
jasmin_support: Final approval? If no objections I'll publish the status banner and queue the email send for T-24h and T-1h reminders. :thumbsup:
eric_pm: Approved. Add opt-out process to the email (reply + CSM). :+1:
sam_ops: All good from ops. Will watch canary and escalate if rollback criteria hit.
jasmin_support: Done — promoting staging entry to public and queuing email templates. I'll post the live statuspage link once promoted.
statusbot: Public status entry published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1918205555
jasmin_support: Thanks everyone — will follow up in this thread with postmortem if anything unexpected occurs.
